meta.problem: Heather and Dave each received a small pie to enjoy. Heather likes to cut her pie into 4 pieces, and Dave likes to cut his pie into 8 pieces. After enjoying their snack, Heather and Dave compared their pie to see who has eaten less.

steps.answer: Both have eaten the same amount of their pies.
